fact: The National Payment Systems (Authorisation and Licensing) (Amendment) Regulations 2024 (GN 239 of 2024), made by the Bank of Mauritius on 11 October 2024, amend the 2021 licensing regulations, adding e-money conditions on customer money, no cash withdrawal and wallet caps.
title: National Payment Systems (Authorisation and Licensing) (Amendment) Regulations 2024, Government Notice No. 239 of 2024
publisher: Bank of Mauritius, Government Gazette of Mauritius
